description: This file defines the InspectorScanClient class, a client used to interact with the AWS Inspector Scan service, extending the AwsClient class and providing methods to perform scans.

classes.name: InspectorScanClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with the AWS Inspector Scan service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: scanSbom
methods.description: Performs a scan of SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) for the specified arguments.

methods.name: scanSbomAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous SBOM scan with the provided arguments, returning a promise.
